requirements.evidence: Every contract item is present: app/Models/Entity.php:15-40 (getRouteKeyName() = 'slug', memberships(), users() through entity_memberships, owner() hasOne filtered to role owner); app/Models/EntityMembership.php:15-45 (fillable, role cast to UserRole, owner/admin/employee scopes, entity()/user()); app/Models/UserRole.php:5-18 (Owner/Admin/Employee, manageable() = [Admin, Employee]); app/Models/User.php:30-52 (memberships/entities/membershipFor); database/migrations/2026_10_29_101217_create_entities_table.php:7-25 (entities_slug_unique, softDeletes); database/migrations/2026_10_29_101218_create_entity_memberships_table.php:9-24 (cascade FKs, role default employee, owner_seq storedAs CASE, entity_memberships_entity_user_unique, entity_memberships_one_owner); factories and both policies match the spec. The only shortfall is that the DB-level owner invariant and policy matrix are not demonstrated by any test.

conventions.evidence: Follows most rules: generated-style migrations with reversible down() (database/migrations/2026_10_29_101217_create_entities_table.php:24-25), deliberate $fillable (app/Models/EntityMembership.php:15-19), policies for authorization (app/Policies/*), docs and CHANGELOG kept in sync (CHANGELOG.md:9, docs/database-schema.md:139,164). Deviations: the change ships no tests despite the mandatory test-first rule, public relations lack the PHPDoc/return types used elsewhere (app/Models/Entity.php:25-40), and the docs call the index a 'partial unique index' when it is not.

security.evidence: Authorization is server-side in policies on every ability: app/Policies/EntityPolicy.php:12-35 (create true, view = member, update/delete = owner|admin, manageSettings = owner) and app/Policies/EntityMembershipPolicy.php:11-38 (view = member, assignRole = owner|admin, delete blocks owner then allows self then owner|admin). role is cast to UserRole and compared strictly. No views/unescaped output or secrets. Caveat: role is mass-assignable (app/Models/EntityMembership.php:15-19).

tests.evidence: change.diff adds only app/Models/*, app/Policies/*, database/factories/*, database/migrations/*, CHANGELOG.md and docs/database-schema.md; no tests/ files are added, so none of the requirements (owner uniqueness, policy matrix, factory states) are covered.

simplicity.evidence: Lean, direct models and policies; reuses enum casts and native hasOne/belongsToMany rather than new abstractions. Minor duplication of the owner/admin check between app/Policies/EntityPolicy.php:49-55 and app/Policies/EntityMembershipPolicy.php:20-21,36-37.

readability.evidence: Clear names, small focused methods, no dead code or debug output. Inconsistency: EntityMembership and User relations have return types/docblocks (app/Models/EntityMembership.php:43-50, app/Models/User.php:31-43) while Entity relations do not (app/Models/Entity.php:25-40).

scope.evidence: Everything in the diff serves the task: models, enum, policies, factories, the two migrations and the required docs/CHANGELOG updates (CHANGELOG.md:9, docs/database-schema.md:139,164). No routes, pages, session handling or other out-of-scope features.

issues.explanation: The change ships zero Pest/PHPUnit tests, violating the project's mandatory test-first rule and leaving the owner_seq constraint, factory states and every policy branch unverified.
The docs describe entity_memberships_one_owner as a 'partial unique index', but it is a plain unique index on (entity_id, owner_seq) that relies on NULL semantics; calling it partial is inaccurate.
role is mass-assignable, so a future generic create($request->all()) path could let a caller write role='owner'; consider guarding role and assigning it explicitly.
memberships(), owner() and users() lack the return types/docblocks used on the sibling EntityMembership and User relations, making the model style inconsistent.

The owner/admin role check is duplicated in EntityPolicy::isManager and EntityMembershipPolicy::assignRole/delete (app/Policies/EntityMembershipPolicy.php:20-21,36-37); a single helper would avoid drift.

review.summary: The change implements the entity/membership data model, UserRole enum, factories, policies and migrations, and updates the schema docs and CHANGELOG in line with the task. The implementation looks correct and well scoped, but it ships no tests at all, which violates the project's mandatory test-first convention and leaves the owner-uniqueness constraint and policy matrix unverified; there are also minor doc and mass-assignment nits.
